svg.title: Exact Bernoulli estimator risks
svg.desc: Three sample sizes and three shrinkage strengths. Central improvements coexist with boundary bias.
svg.text: Same loss, different risk: shrinkage helps in some regions
T_a = (K+a)/(n+2a), K ~ Binomial(n,p). Each panel compares the same three rules.
Risk is expected squared error, not a probability density. There is no uniform winner here.
